//: Single root TS config for the @fujuntao/pi-aio package.
No `files`/`include`: tsc defaults to every `.ts`/`.d.ts` under the repo
root (excluding node_modules), so `extensions/**/*.ts` is type-checked as
soon as it exists. A root `global.d.ts` keeps the program non-empty while
`extensions/` is empty; `@types/node` provides the `node:*` ambient types.
